content: ⌊ DRAFT g Upon reception of a FUP message, CanTSyn shall 1. retrieve the following data from the FUP message 43 of 92 Document ID 674: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverCAN Specification of Time Synchronization over CAN AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • the OVS field and • the SyncTimeNSec field 2. calculate T4 = OVS + SyncTimeNSec in the RX indication routine ( CanTSyn_RxIndication ).
